summary: Expose authenticated local runtime-start diagnostics and recover exact stored nonlaunch closure witnesses

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild. Reconciliation recognizes already-retained operation-bound before-backend, native-rejection and never-dispatched closure witnesses.

schema.detail: No persisted schema change. Diagnostic creation timestamps come from UUIDv7 operation identifiers; unavailable dispatch and finish timestamps remain null.

rules.detail: No desired-state or physical retirement rule change. Missing, mismatched or producer-open evidence cannot authorize closure.

compatibility.detail: Adds an authenticated read-only client diagnostic endpoint. Existing endpoints are unchanged.

manual.detail: No manual cleanup is required when a valid exact stored nonlaunch witness exists.

recovery.detail: Recovered closure is validated against the original operation and retained request provenance inside the writer fence before taking the lazy pass-shared PTY snapshot. A generic launch error, elapsed time or unrelated PTY tag never supplies a witness.
